question: Should memory-core Dreaming accept localized structural labels/status text, and if so should the public contract be a constrained `dreaming.language` locale, a template override, or the broader Dream Diary prompt design?
rationale: The request is useful but adds public plugin config and localization policy, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive and product-owned rather than a routine bug fix.

options.title: Review the linked PR under the broader design
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101323 as the active implementation candidate while checking it against the broader contract discussion in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/79223.

options.title: Ask for a narrower locale-only contract
options.body: Keep this issue open and request a proposal limited to stable built-in locales and centralized labels, without template or prompt override surface.

options.title: Defer Dreaming localization
options.body: Keep English structural labels for now and leave the broader localization request on the canonical product backlog.
